release_notes:
1. Restores the native classic PrestaShop UI layout (v1.21.3 design) with full hook integrity.
2. Adds dedicated configuration fields for Raw GTM container scripts (<head> and <body> noscript injection).
3. Product Catalog Identifier Strategy organized with wide dropdown and comprehensive, real-world guidance.
4. Enables seamless 1-click update in PrestaShop 8 Back Office bypassing downgrade locks.
